title: Factors for Decline in Happiness Measure in Quality of Life Survey
what_it_is: Factors for Decline in Happiness Measure in Quality of Life Survey

sections.label: Well-being measurement scales
sections.summary: The survey measured well-being using scales including the satisfaction with life scale and the Cantril self-anchoring scale, also used by the World Happiness Report.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The authors of this survey measured well-being using a variety of scales, including the satisfaction with life scale and the Cantril self-anchoring scale, which is also used as the primary happiness measure by the World Happiness Report of the United Nations' Sustainable Development Solutions Network.

sections.label: Singapore in World Happiness Report
sections.summary: In the World Happiness Report 2023, Singapore is the happiest country in Asia and the 25th happiest in the world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In the World Happiness Report 2023 that I cited earlier, Singapore is the happiest country in Asia and the 25th happiest country in the world.

sections.label: Happiness definition and mental well-being strategy
sections.summary: Happiness is defined as pleasure or contentment, distinct from mental health, and the Government's national strategy and SG Mental Well-being Network address mental well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: One definition is that happiness is a state of feeling or showing pleasure or contentment and is distinct from mental health needs or issues.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We are not aware of existing studies done in Singapore that correlate both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: But, as a whole, the Government has implemented a holistic approach to enhance Singaporeans’ mental health and mental well-being through the national strategy we announced in October 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: The SG Mental Well-being Network is the community pillar to this strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Through the Network, we bring together partners and citizens to strengthen mental well-being and mental health outcomes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We have also set up Well-being Circles in the communities to strengthen community and peer support and equip citizens with skills to care for their own mental well-being and that of others around them.

sections.label: NUS QOL survey informs strategy
sections.summary: The NUS QOL survey and other reports inform community engagement and the National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The short answer to his second question is, in fact, yes, and we look at NUS' QOL survey among many other reports that MCCY either commissions or does inhouse.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And all of these surveys and studies do inform how we work on the ground in terms of engaging different levels in the community – our youths, seniors and people who are working – and these effectively inform our National Mental Health and Well-being Strategy, which we will go into detail again in the debate later on.
